tool.name: TeleOCR
tool.summary: High-performance Multimodal open-weights model by XingChen-AGI, trending with over 809 community likes and 27,904 downloads on Hugging Face, incorporating an architecture of xingChen-AGI image text to text architecture with community-tuned weights. The model demonstrates competitive performance across verified evaluations, including Trending Score: 697, Likes: 809, Downloads: 27,904. With its Open Weights design, it supports diverse local and enterprise deployment profiles under the Apache-2.0 license.

tool.usage:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("XingChen-AGI/TeleOCR", device_map="auto")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("XingChen-AGI/TeleOCR")
tool.limitations: Requires GPU VRAM or quantization for efficient local deployment.
